tex_content.html:
Proposition
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0066, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0067, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0068, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0069, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0070 1. Proposition 2.36\group neckpinch

For a maximal rotationally symmetric solution with $|\psi _s|\le 1$, $R\ge 0$, and at least one neck, the smallest neck becomes singular in finite time, the singularity is Type I, a scale-invariant pinching estimate holds for $K/L$, and the neck profile is asymptotic to the shrinking cylinder with $r_{\min }(t)\sim \sqrt{2(n-1)(T-t)}$.
